messages:
Aisha: Hey team — prepping FjordTech Dedicated bring-up this weekend. Quick checklist: quota applied, warm pool primed, autoscale policy set? Need runbook owner. @Marco can you confirm quota number and who runs loadscript?
Marco: Quota is 800k tokens/min (customer committed). I'm out Fri morning but leaving infra steps in the runbook. @Devon you're on load runner?
Devon: Yep can take loadrunner. Plan: start low 10% soak -> 50% -> 100% spike test. Will run k6 script in prod-ish zone. Sharing script snippet: ```
k6 run --vus 100 --duration 20m script.js
```
Priya: Can we double-check autoscale cooldown? Last time we saw thrash at 30s. Suggest cooldown 3m and headroom 20%.
Marco: Agreed. Current policy is scale-out threshold 70%, scale-in 30s. I'll update to 3m. Also ensure prefix cache is purged? @capacity-bot any notes on priming?
capacity-bot: Capacity-aware: Warm pool primed with 50 instances, KV cache prewarmed for models: redwood-7b-v2. Warning: one instance showed GPU mem pressure at 85% during last priming.
Aisha: :thumbsup: Please record the memory pressure in the runbook and set an alert. Also need customer enablement time window: they want cutover at 02:00 UTC Saturday.
Devon: Load script includes a ramp that aligns to 02:00 UTC. I'll run a smoke at 23:00 Fri to sanity-check. Will post logs here.
Marco: I updated the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fjordtech-bringup — added autoscale cooldown change and alerting thresholds.
Priya: Reminder: get customer packed prompts for evals. If quality regressions appear we need rollback plan to smaller model or higher mem config.
Aisha: Assigning canaries: first 10% traffic route via canary policy for 30m, auto-fallback on 5% error spike. @Devon please test rollback trigger.
Devon: Will simulate error spike by dropping 6% of requests via header injection. Pasting test header: `x-test-failure: 1`
Marco: Ops note: KMS rotate scheduled at 01:30 UTC — I'll postpone to 03:30 to avoid overlap.
capacity-bot: Checklist status: quota applied ✅, warm pool ✅, autoscale updated ✅, runbook updated ✅, canary rule ✅.
Aisha: Great. I'll send enablement invite to FjordTech for 01:45 UTC. Anyone else? otherwise closing prep.
Priya: I'll join, will bring the prompt set.
